sourceNotes.rawContent:
Clean, modern, and effortlessly cool — our Cross Hatch Texture Hoop Earrings feature a polished gold crescent hoop with subtle diagonal crosshatch engraving that adds depth and texture without being loud. Minimalist enough for everyday wear, stylish enough to stand out.
- 316L Stainless Steel — rust-proof, tarnish-proof & skin-safe
- Gold-plated finish — rich, long-lasting shine
- Waterproof & sweat-resistant — built for everyday wear
- Subtle crosshatch engraving on polished gold surface
- Medium hoop — versatile day-to-night piece
Pairs with: Everything — truly an everyday essential hoop.
Stainless steel is highly durable and water-resistant. Avoid prolonged exposure to harsh chemicals and perfumes.
